source: 2014/TSB Vol 14 No 19 - Ford Focus Coolant Adapter.pdf
title: Ford Focus Coolant Adapters
lead: MOC has developed 2 new adapters (Part No. 94342 and 94343) to service the cooling system of a Ford Focus along with any other vehicle that have the same size quick disconnect fitting.
body: *In order to connect Part No. 94343 to the Coolant Machine, you must have the universal adapters, which are included in the standard adapter kit.
